cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. My place card should say Chairperson, not simply Jo. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then nobody will struggle with the extra word.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no room on the card.

mechanism: A takes charge of a formal place setting but yields name order and lettering method so B will display A chairperson status visibly.
confusable: Unlike correcting a mistaken name, A needs standing publicly marked; borrowed authority must accommodate B physical constraints to secure respect.
comparison: A small place card and larger surface differ from a spoken title during barbecue service.
seedUse: Use D57-b Jo/chairperson/card space/plate and S02-b adapting the medium to participant limits.
